create_OnnxController: create an OnnxController instance with a policy path, default angles, control dt, and substeps for Apollo humanoid control
run_OnnxController_get_obs: run the OnnxController get_obs method to extract observation vectors from MuJoCo model and data
run_OnnxController_get_control: run the OnnxController get_control method to apply ONNX policy predictions as MuJoCo control signals
build_load_callback: build a load_callback function that initializes MuJoCo model, data, and OnnxController for joystick-controlled Apollo simulation
test_viewer_launch: test the viewer.launch call with load_callback to launch an interactive MuJoCo simulation with ONNX policy and gamepad input
